snippet.title: 현명한 아내의 통찰 Insights from a Wise Daughter-in-Law
snippet.description:
A story of a wise daughter-in-law's insights and the blossoming of her leadership.

Once upon a time, a daughter-in-law who had married into a poor family went out to the fields one day and gathered a few bundles of straw, then asked her husband to make seven bags out of it for the family. The family consisted of the father-in-law, mother-in-law, her husband, herself, two brothers-in-law, and one sister-in-law, totaling seven people. The husband made seven bags from the straw the next day. That evening, the daughter-in-law gathered the family and, while distributing the bags one by one, she made a request: 'From tomorrow, anyone who goes out should take this bag with them. When you come back, you can fill it with broken twigs, fallen leaves, or even weeds or stones; just make sure to bring the bag back full.' The family thought it would not be difficult to bring back weeds or stones, so they all agreed to do it. The next day, the father-in-law brought back a bag full of leftovers from the riverbank, the mother-in-law picked weeds from the roadside, the husband gathered broken twigs from the hillside, and she herself picked a lot of dandelions from the fields. However, the two brothers-in-law, who had been quite unsatisfied with the proposal, brought back a bag full of small stones that overflowed from the road, while the sister-in-law gathered rag scraps. The daughter-in-law thanked them for keeping their promise and politely greeted them. She took the burnable scraps, twigs, and rag pieces to the kitchen to use as firewood, and used the dandelions she had brought for a side dish. The weeds the mother-in-law brought were piled in the front yard to make fertilizer, and the stones brought by the brothers-in-law were gathered in a corner of the backyard. After a few days of this, one day the daughter-in-law went out to the fields and gathered some rice ears, which she ground to cook rice. The family, having eaten a hearty meal of rice for the first time in a while, thought it would be better to bring something useful next time.
As a result, the next day, the father-in-law went around various fields after the harvest and picked up leftover potato vines, the husband went to the mountains and gathered fallen chestnuts, I picked a lot of mountain berries, the brothers-in-law caught many carp by the stream, and the sister-in-law gathered a lot of shepherd's purse.So, after neatly trimming and organizing those things, we set the table, and it instantly became a plentiful feast. The family members, excited by the bountiful table, began to bring in more useful items.They went to the back mountain to dig up bellflower roots, went to the river to catch big fish, and wandered through the rice fields picking up abandoned rice ears, potato vines, and sweet potato stems.The daughter-in-law, as a prank on the brothers-in-law, piled up the small stones they had brought over the past few days in a corner of the backyard to make a small shrine, and every dawn, she filled a bowl with pure water and placed it there, praying for the family's peace and success.As small amounts of money started to accumulate, the family worked even harder on money-making tasks, and the wealth began to grow day by day.As this continued, the law of momentum, where money makes more money, became a reality, and within just 5 years, they became the most talked-about wealthy family in the neighborhood.The saying 'Little by little, a mountain is formed' probably refers to this. The daughter-in-law's idea gives us many lessons.

snippet.title: 스테이블코인과 지역화폐 Stablecoins and local currencies
snippet.description:
지역화폐와 스테이블코인의 융합 가능성

블록체인 기술을 매개로 지역화폐와 스테이블코인은 상호 보완적인 융합 가능성을 가진다. 스테이블코인의 구조적 특성을 지역화폐에 접목하면 지역화폐의 유통 추적성, 부정 사용 방지, 조건부 지급 등의 기능을 고도화할 수 있다.13 즉, 블록체인 기반의 지역화폐는 모든 거래 내역을 투명하게 기록하고 실시간 정산을 가능하게 하여 기존 지역화폐의 행정 비용 절감 및 자금 회전율 개선에 기여할 수 있다.13
특히, 스테이블코인의 확장성을 활용하여 지역화폐가 특정 지역에만 국한되지 않고 넓은 영역으로 확장될 수 있다는 잠재력이 있다.13 이는 관광객들이 환전 없이 스테이블코인 기반 지역화폐로 편리하게 결제할 수 있는 시스템을 구축하여 지역 관광 활성화에 기여할 수 있다.13 또한, 자원봉사, 환경 보호 활동 등 사회적 가치를 창출하는 행위에 대해 스테이블코인 기반 지역화폐로 보상하는 시스템을 쉽게 연계할 수 있어, 지역 사회의 참여와 활성화를 더욱 촉진할 수 있다.13


The Potential for Convergence of Local Currencies and Stablecoins

Local currencies and stablecoins have the potential for complementary convergence through blockchain technology. Incorporating the structural characteristics of stablecoins into local currencies can enhance their functionality, including traceability, fraud prevention, and conditional payments. In other words, blockchain-based local currencies can transparently record all transaction details and enable real-time settlement, contributing to reduced administrative costs and improved fund turnover.
In particular, leveraging the scalability of stablecoins offers the potential for local currencies to expand beyond specific regions and into broader areas. This could contribute to the revitalization of local tourism by establishing a system where tourists can conveniently make payments with stablecoin-based local currencies without the need for currency exchange. Furthermore, systems that reward socially valuable activities, such as volunteer work and environmental protection, with stablecoin-based local currencies can be easily integrated, further stimulating community participation and vitality.

snippet.title: 현명한 아내의 통찰 Insights from a Wise Daughter-in-Law
snippet.description:
A story of a wise daughter-in-law's insights and the blossoming of her leadership.

Once upon a time, a daughter-in-law who had married into a poor family went out to the fields one day and gathered a few bundles of straw, then asked her husband to make seven bags out of it for the family. The family consisted of the father-in-law, mother-in-law, her husband, herself, two brothers-in-law, and one sister-in-law, totaling seven people. The husband made seven bags from the straw the next day. That evening, the daughter-in-law gathered the family and, while distributing the bags one by one, she made a request: 'From tomorrow, anyone who goes out should take this bag with them. When you come back, you can fill it with broken twigs, fallen leaves, or even weeds or stones; just make sure to bring the bag back full.' The family thought it would not be difficult to bring back weeds or stones, so they all agreed to do it. The next day, the father-in-law brought back a bag full of leftovers from the riverbank, the mother-in-law picked weeds from the roadside, the husband gathered broken twigs from the hillside, and she herself picked a lot of dandelions from the fields. However, the two brothers-in-law, who had been quite unsatisfied with the proposal, brought back a bag full of small stones that overflowed from the road, while the sister-in-law gathered rag scraps. The daughter-in-law thanked them for keeping their promise and politely greeted them. She took the burnable scraps, twigs, and rag pieces to the kitchen to use as firewood, and used the dandelions she had brought for a side dish. The weeds the mother-in-law brought were piled in the front yard to make fertilizer, and the stones brought by the brothers-in-law were gathered in a corner of the backyard. After a few days of this, one day the daughter-in-law went out to the fields and gathered some rice ears, which she ground to cook rice. The family, having eaten a hearty meal of rice for the first time in a while, thought it would be better to bring something useful next time.
As a result, the next day, the father-in-law went around various fields after the harvest and picked up leftover potato vines, the husband went to the mountains and gathered fallen chestnuts, I picked a lot of mountain berries, the brothers-in-law caught many carp by the stream, and the sister-in-law gathered a lot of shepherd's purse.So, after neatly trimming and organizing those things, we set the table, and it instantly became a plentiful feast. The family members, excited by the bountiful table, began to bring in more useful items.They went to the back mountain to dig up bellflower roots, went to the river to catch big fish, and wandered through the rice fields picking up abandoned rice ears, potato vines, and sweet potato stems.The daughter-in-law, as a prank on the brothers-in-law, piled up the small stones they had brought over the past few days in a corner of the backyard to make a small shrine, and every dawn, she filled a bowl with pure water and placed it there, praying for the family's peace and success.As small amounts of money started to accumulate, the family worked even harder on money-making tasks, and the wealth began to grow day by day.As this continued, the law of momentum, where money makes more money, became a reality, and within just 5 years, they became the most talked-about wealthy family in the neighborhood.The saying 'Little by little, a mountain is formed' probably refers to this. The daughter-in-law's idea gives us many lessons.

snippet.title: 스테이블코인과 지역화폐 Stablecoins and local currencies
snippet.description:
지역화폐와 스테이블코인의 융합 가능성

블록체인 기술을 매개로 지역화폐와 스테이블코인은 상호 보완적인 융합 가능성을 가진다. 스테이블코인의 구조적 특성을 지역화폐에 접목하면 지역화폐의 유통 추적성, 부정 사용 방지, 조건부 지급 등의 기능을 고도화할 수 있다.13 즉, 블록체인 기반의 지역화폐는 모든 거래 내역을 투명하게 기록하고 실시간 정산을 가능하게 하여 기존 지역화폐의 행정 비용 절감 및 자금 회전율 개선에 기여할 수 있다.13
특히, 스테이블코인의 확장성을 활용하여 지역화폐가 특정 지역에만 국한되지 않고 넓은 영역으로 확장될 수 있다는 잠재력이 있다.13 이는 관광객들이 환전 없이 스테이블코인 기반 지역화폐로 편리하게 결제할 수 있는 시스템을 구축하여 지역 관광 활성화에 기여할 수 있다.13 또한, 자원봉사, 환경 보호 활동 등 사회적 가치를 창출하는 행위에 대해 스테이블코인 기반 지역화폐로 보상하는 시스템을 쉽게 연계할 수 있어, 지역 사회의 참여와 활성화를 더욱 촉진할 수 있다.13


The Potential for Convergence of Local Currencies and Stablecoins

Local currencies and stablecoins have the potential for complementary convergence through blockchain technology. Incorporating the structural characteristics of stablecoins into local currencies can enhance their functionality, including traceability, fraud prevention, and conditional payments. In other words, blockchain-based local currencies can transparently record all transaction details and enable real-time settlement, contributing to reduced administrative costs and improved fund turnover.
In particular, leveraging the scalability of stablecoins offers the potential for local currencies to expand beyond specific regions and into broader areas. This could contribute to the revitalization of local tourism by establishing a system where tourists can conveniently make payments with stablecoin-based local currencies without the need for currency exchange. Furthermore, systems that reward socially valuable activities, such as volunteer work and environmental protection, with stablecoin-based local currencies can be easily integrated, further stimulating community participation and vitality.

특히, 스테이블코인의 확장성을 활용하여 지역화폐가 특정 지역에만 국한되지 않고 넓은 영역으로 확장될 수 있다는 잠재력이 있다.13 이는 관광객들이 환전 없이 스테이블코인 기반 지역화폐로 편리하게 결제할 수 있는 시스템을 구축하여 지역 관광 활성화에 기여할 수 있다.13 또한, 자원봉사, 환경 보호 활동 등 사회적 가치를 창출하는 행위에 대해 스테이블코인 기반 지역화폐로 보상하는 시스템을 쉽게 연계할 수 있어, 지역 사회의 참여와 활성화를 더욱 촉진할 수 있다.13

Local currencies and stablecoins have the potential for complementary convergence through blockchain technology. Incorporating the structural characteristics of stablecoins into local currencies can enhance their functionality, including traceability, fraud prevention, and conditional payments. In other words, blockchain-based local currencies can transparently record all transaction details and enable real-time settlement, contributing to reduced administrative costs and improved fund turnover.
In particular, leveraging the scalability of stablecoins offers the potential for local currencies to expand beyond specific regions and into broader areas. This could contribute to the revitalization of local tourism by establishing a system where tourists can conveniently make payments with stablecoin-based local currencies without the need for currency exchange. Furthermore, systems that reward socially valuable activities, such as volunteer work and environmental protection, with stablecoin-based local currencies can be easily integrated, further stimulating community participation and vitality.
